description: This file defines the WebhookTaskerProducerService class, which manages queuing webhook tasks for various events such as booking, form submission, recording, and OOO creation. It interacts with a WebhookTasker to deliver webhooks and uses a logger for debugging and error reporting.

classes.name: WebhookTaskerProducerService
classes.description: A service class responsible for queuing webhook tasks for various events, delegating delivery to a WebhookTasker, and logging operations.

methods.name: queueBookingCreatedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for booking creation event.

methods.name: queueBookingCancelledWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for booking cancellation event.

methods.name: queueBookingRescheduledWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for booking rescheduling event.

methods.name: queueBookingRequestedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for booking requested event.

methods.name: queueBookingRejectedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for booking rejection event.

methods.name: queueBookingPaymentInitiatedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for payment initiation.

methods.name: queueBookingPaidWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for booking payment completed.

methods.name: queueBookingNoShowUpdatedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for no-show update.

methods.name: queueFormSubmittedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for form submission, generating an operation ID if not provided.

methods.name: queueRecordingReadyWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook indicating recording is ready, generating an operation ID if not provided.

methods.name: queueOOOCreatedWebhook
methods.description: Queues a webhook for OOO (Out of Office) creation, generating an operation ID if not provided.

methods.name: queueBookingWebhook
methods.description: Internal helper to queue booking-related webhooks, excluding payment events.

methods.name: queuePaymentWebhook
methods.description: Internal helper to queue payment-related webhooks.

methods.name: queueTask
methods.description: Internal helper that sends the webhook task payload to the WebhookTasker and handles logging and errors.
